title: Expose Semantic And Presentation Editing
summary: Added separate semantic-intent and presentation authoring controls for roles, lineage, provenance, salience, correctness disclosure, typed gaps, spacing, tempo, and path preference; edits emit typed regeneration requests, revise cached plans, and preserve the mounted stage.

sourceRefs.summary: Approved slice intent, risk, verification, commit boundary, and stop condition.
Defines renderer-free authoring state and typed regeneration requests while keeping geometry and keyframes out of the model-facing contract.

expectedLearning: Whether this slice advances the governed grammar while preserving deterministic semantic continuity and the existing shared player boundary.
allowedWork: Only implement the named slice and its focused tests, docs, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not broaden into live model providers, a general CAS, general graph layout, a second playback clock, arbitrary model-authored geometry, or unrelated product work.
